author: znq19
description: OpenAI compatible provider bridge: stream-first + envelope fallback LLM client. Solves non-standard endpoints whose non-stream responses are wrapped in model_extra envelope (e.g. deepseek cline channel).

zh.description: OpenAI 兼容 Provider 桥接：流式优先 + 信封兜底。解决部分端点非流式响应被塞进 model_extra 信封、推理字段名非标准（reasoning）、流式 token 用量位置非标准等问题。
